records.issue_text: src/sentry/spans/buffer.py:434 — [confidence 100; P1; blocking] Replacing SSCAN with `p.zscan(key, cursor=cursor, count=self.segment_page_size)` and SADD with `p.zadd(` at line 197 while retaining the existing `span-buf:s:` key namespace makes upgraded workers raise Redis WRONGTYPE on pre-deployment SET buffers, blocking flushes and inserts until those buffered spans expire, while rollback workers likewise reject newly written sorted sets because the change provides no compatible reader, conversion, or drain transition.
records.rationale: The diff shows that in buffer.py line 197, the code changes from using Redis SET operations (sadd) to sorted set operations (zadd), and in line 434, from sscan to zscan. The key namespace 'span-buf:s:{project_and_trace}:{parent_span_id}' remains the same. During a rolling deployment, old workers would still use sadd/sscan expecting SET type, while new workers use zadd/zscan expecting ZSET type. Redis will return WRONGTYPE error when a command is used on a key of the wrong type. There is no migration logic, version detection, or transition handling visible in the diff.
